title: spec: the flows.approvals translation rows read live, and ApprovalRequestRow's label docblocks name the reader's-locale label
body:
Closes #24979

Clause-②: no (ledger and docblock text only: no shape, key, default, accepted value or export moves)

## What

The follow-up owed by #24863's landing (PR #24977, commit ba69b168be). plugin-approvals now serves an approval request's flow, step and object labels in the reader's locale (`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/reader-locale-labels.ts`). The spec side still said otherwise in two places. This PR fixes both:

1. **`packages/spec/liveness/translation.json`**: `flows.approvals` and its one drilled child `flows.approvals.label` flip `planned` to `live`. This is the step the row's own planned note asked for ("Flip to `live` on the commit that cites that reader"). Both rows now cite the reader by `file#symbol` anchors. The child also cites its producer chain. The generated count shard `liveness/state-counts/translation.md` was regenerated with `gen:liveness-counts` (live 29 to 30, planned 1 to 0). The `translation` Notes cell in `liveness/README.md` gains one sentence for the flip, as the gate's stale-count message asks.
2. **`packages/spec/src/contracts/approval-service.ts`**: the `ApprovalRequestRow` docblocks for `process_label`, `step_label`, `current_step_label` and `object_label` now say what is served. Each is the reader's-locale label, falling back to the stored snapshot (for `object_label`, the object's schema label). The stored columns are never rewritten by a read.

Text only: no type, key, default, accepted value or export moves. The docblocks ship in `dist/contracts/index.d.ts`, so this carries a `@objectstack/spec` `patch` changeset (`.changeset/24979-approvals-label-live.md`).

## Each docblock statement, verified against plugin-approvals at origin/main a39389eb51

None of these files is touched by this diff, so the line numbers hold at this PR's head too.

| Docblock statement | Where plugin-approvals does it |
|---|---|
| The flow label is picked from `flows.FLOW.label`, the step label from `flows.FLOW.approvals.NODE.label`, the object label from `objects.OBJECT.label` | `reader-locale-labels.ts:73` `flowLabelKey`, `:78` `approvalStepLabelKey`, `:153` `objectLabelKey` |
| Picked through the i18n service in the read's `ExecutionContext.locale`, negotiated by `resolveBundleLocale` | `reader-locale-labels.ts:128-155` `readerLabelsFor` (`:134` negotiation, `:140` `service.t(key, locale)`); `approval-service.ts:8250-8259` `readerLabels`; `approvals-plugin.ts:273` wires `i18nServiceSource` |
| No locale, no i18n service or no pack entry: the snapshot is served | `reader-locale-labels.ts:132-133` (no locale or no service gives `undefined`), `:142` (a miss echoes the key and picks nothing), `:178`, `:181`, `:188` (overlay only when picked) |
| Picked on `listRequests`, `getRequest` and a write's echoed request | `approval-service.ts:8229-8230` (`listRequests`), `:8371-8372` (`loadRequest`); `getRequest` (`:8337-8338`) and `readBackRequest` (`:8326`, every decision or write echo) go through `loadRequest` |
| `step_label` and `current_step_label` are always the same value | `approval-service.ts:1270`, `:1275` (both from one `requestDisplayLabels` value); `reader-locale-labels.ts:182-183` (both overlaid together) |
| Fallback is the authored label as snapshotted at open, else the humanized machine name | `display-labels.ts:79-80` `requestDisplayLabels` (column, else the node-config snapshot, else the humanized name) |
| The stored column is never rewritten; the generic data door and list views serve the snapshot | `reader-locale-labels.ts:56-59` (header, "What stays"); the overlay mutates only the served row object (`:174-189`) |
| `object_label` falls back to the object's schema label | `approval-service.ts:7429-7433` `objectLabelOf` (`schema.label`), set at `:7378` and `:7574-7575` before the overlay |

## Deferred, not in this PR

The optional `flowLabelKey` / `flowApprovalLabelKey` helper beside `flowRefusalMessageKey` (issue body, "Optional") is not added. A new `@objectstack/spec` export is a widening, which the claim's Clause-② `no` excludes. `reader-locale-labels.ts` keeps spelling both keys locally, held to `TranslationDataSchema` by `reader-locale-labels.test.ts`.

## Verification (head da0364f825)

All runs below were taken on this head (no commit after them). The spec build and tests ran under the shared verify lock on a shared box.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The edited docblocks are in `dist/contracts/index.d.ts` (one hit for the new text), so the published artifact moves and the changeset is a `patch`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` (tsc, scripts and test typecheck) followed by `vitest run`: `Test Files 778 passed (778)`, `Tests 22683 passed, 1 todo`; `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test:repo`: `Test Files 72 passed (72)`, `Tests 1237 passed (1237)`; `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:liveness`: red before regeneration, as it should be (`state-counts/translation.md is STALE`: live 29 to 30, planned 1 to 0). After `gen:liveness-counts` it is green: every `path#symbol` anchor resolves (976 of 976), key-mention 747 anchored plus 1 exempt, and `state-counts/ is current`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: `All 14 generated artifacts are up to date`, against the dist this branch built.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 84 families for this diff, and all 84 were run. 81 exited 0. `--ran` with recorded exit codes: `84 derived, 81 run, 3 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. Three were NOT MEASURED. Each exited 3 because a build it needs was missing, so it checked nothing: `@objectstack/lint check:doc-formula-expressions` (needs formula and lint dist), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needs every package's dist), and `check:lean-entry-closure` (needs objectql dist). They are left to CI. The changeset gates (`check-changeset-no-major`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`), `check:nul-bytes`, `check-spec-docblock-symbol-anchors`, `check:api-surface` and `check:docs` are among the 81 that exited 0.
- `pnpm lint` (repo-wide) was not run locally. It belongs to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- No open PR touches any of the four changed files under `packages/spec` (all 14 open PRs' file lists scanned before opening).
- `flow_steps[].label` has no docblock that names the authored label (its member docblock is silent on the label's source), so it is left unchanged, although `attachFlowSteps` (`approval-service.ts:8501`) names steps by the same pick.
